title: llm-gemini 0.36 adds Gemini 4 Carbon support
summary: llm-gemini 0.36 adds support for Gemini 4 Carbon, Google&\#x27;s model that was initially limited to a subset of cyber defenders and is now available to everyone else. The plugin exposes Carbon&\#x27;s low, medium, and high thinking-effort settings, with medium as the default. Google priced the model at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens at launch, with those rates scheduled to double to $4/$20 on December 1.
